reviews.text:
I have two cats, one 13 years old and the other 7 months, and Top Tails was a great service. They were very reliable and a pleasure to work with, and I would definitely book again. I had them come twice per day, morning and evening, to feed and water the cats and clean the litter.

While you’re away, you receive detailed notes and pictures after each visit, which are especially nice when you miss your pets. Top Tails is extremely detail-oriented and clearly wants to understand your animals and their routines so they can take the best possible care of them.

They also have an app where you can store pet profiles, photos, contacts, emergency information, and feeding schedules. The messaging feature makes it very easy to stay in touch, and communication was excellent throughout.

After a few days away, I came home to a clean apartment and happy kitties. I couldn’t have been happier myself. I’ve used another cat-sitting service in the past, and Top Tails has them beat by a million, seriously.

Tanya and her TopTails service was exactly what we needed to feel comfortable with leaving our dog Lucy at home while we were away. Tanya was very attentive, spent a Significant amount of time with us prior to our booking getting to know us, our dog and our home environment. Tanya checked in with us, sent photos and put our weary minds at ease knowing that our dog (who is highly anxious) was receiving attention, snugs and that her schedule was being met.

We are so grateful to have found Tanya’s services and we will definitely be booking with her in the near future.

Thank you Tanya!

Tanya has been absolutely wonderful with my dog! She is reliable, caring, and always goes above and beyond to make sure he is happy and well cared for. It’s such a relief knowing he’s in such good hands when I can’t be there. She is communicative, trustworthy, and it’s obvious how much she genuinely loves animals. My dog is always excited to see her, which says everything. I highly recommend Tanya to anyone looking for a dependable and compassionate dog walker. Thank you for taking such great care of my pup!

Tanya is incredible! We found Top Tails after moving to the area and deciding we needed a dog walker for our sweet English Bulldog. After the first meet and greet, I knew our dog was in good hands. Tanya is extremely communicative, professional, and caring. She literally treated our dog like it was her own! I loved that we got little daily progress reports every time our dog got a walk, and she let us know if she saw anything out of the ordinary. We appreciate Tanya and everything she does—I highly recommend Top Tails.

Tanya, the owner of Top Tails, is truly one of the best people I’ve met. I cannot have asked for a better person to take care of my baby kitty. He has difficulty walking and cannot get around the house. He’s also on a schedule with bathroom breaks. From first meeting with Tanya, I was put at ease. Even before the consultation, when I expressed his special needs, Tanya made sure to explain the services to make sure she would be the right person that I was looking for. She even hangs out and gives treats to my older cat after I said they both would love Churu. And I only booked services for my younger cat! She’s so great with them and so communicative. I always look forward to her pictures and updates. She’s so consistent, reliable, and treats my cat like her own. She truly cares and it shows. I trust her completely with my babies. I cannot say enough good things about Tanya. I’m incredibly grateful to her and Top Tails!

Top Tails took excellent care of my two sphynx cats, PIMMEE and Billie-Jean, while I was away. I received daily photos and updates that honestly made my day, and communication was always quick and responsive.

When I returned home, the place was spotless and the cats were calm, happy, and clearly well cared for. Their routine was followed closely — treats, wet food, and even oral medication were given without issue.

Most importantly, I could tell PIMMEE and Billie received real attention and first-class care. I would absolutely trust Top Tails with them again.

Top Tails is wonderful! They really take the time to get to know my dog and what makes him comfortable and happy. They communicate very effectively too. I am so grateful to have them as part of my care network for my dog, especially when I have to work all day or be out of town. Highly recommend their services.

Tanya is amazing! I was nervous to hire a walker but I knew I wanted to meet with Tanya, as she has over 20 years experience in the pet care business. After meeting with her, all my nerves melted away with her warmth and experience. She connected with my pup right away and he was always happy to see her. The updates and photos from walks was always a highlight to my husband and my workdays. We were so happy he could get out of the house on days we had to be in the office, especially with someone so conscientious. Tanya also helped around the home, bringing in packages etc if they arrived while we were away. Things like that. I, unfortunately, left my position so I’m home now, but I will absolutely be hiring Tanya for one off walkies, cat sitting, vacations etc and have already recommended her to other pet parents in the neighborhood. Not only is Tanya a consummate professional, she’s so sweet and personable, animals and humans alike feel seen + cared for by her. If you’re on the fence, just hire her!

Top Tails did such an amazing job looking after my two cats when I was traveling out of the country for 2 weeks! We did a few trial runs before the actual trip that really helped to assuage my anxiety about leaving them, and Tanya was so accommodating and kind. I got updates daily and knowing they were well taken care of made my trip so much more enjoyable! Top tails is really dedicated to making sure routines are minimally disrupted and they get more than their basic needs taken care of. I will definitely be using in the future!

Top Tails worked out perfectly for our cat sitting needs during the holidays. Our fur baby was visited everyday, even with an ice storm making travel sketchy. And especially cheerful when we arrived home, which is not always the case.

Top Tails did a great job taking care of our older cat. We really appreciated the photos and updates that were provided each day. It is clear that the team is dedicated, responsible, and truly compassionate towards the animals in their care.

Tanya is amazing! She was very thorough and it was so nice receiving a daily update with photos while we were away. I had so much peace of mind knowing she was there checking up on my kitty giving lots of love and affection and making sure she had everything she needed. I highly recommend her services. Thank you again Tanya!
Great care and excellent communication! My cats love TOP TAILS and they’re always happy and in perfect shape when I arrive home from my trips.

I had the best experience with Tanya and Top Tails! She gave us comfort knowing our cats were well cared for while we were away. She communicated well, gave us photos and daily updates, and kept the litter box clean! When we came home we found she even took out of trash and brought in the mail. Look no further for your pet sitting needs. Thanks so much, Tanya!!!!
Excellent dog walking service- reliable, quick at replying, and kind!

Top Tails is the best! Our dog is very anxious when meeting new people. We struggled finding a consistent sitter that our dog was comfortable with. Top Tails took their time meeting our pup and making her comfortable. 10/10 recommend using them!!

Top Tails has been wonderful to work with, providing reliable service from a truly pet-loving provider! Tanya is great at communicating, sends lots of cute pics & our dog has grown to look forward to her visits!

If I could give 6 stars I would :) The app makes it easy to schedule and pay, the report cards and pics from the visit are great, and most importantly Tanya seems to genuinely care about our pup. We love Top Tails and would absolutely recommend to others looking for a reliable and caring pet sitter.

Top Tails does an excellent job of taking care of my dog! Clear communication, fast message replies and the photos of my dog on his walk always make me feel like he's in the best hands. I cannot recommend this service enough

Top Tails has been great! We love our walker. Layla is a husky, and she can be quite the diva, but she immediately loved our Top Tails walker and they have created a good bond! We do the 15 minute walks 2-3 times a week. Top Tails is also very flexible with my ever-changing wfh schedule. Thanks, Top Tails!
I rescued a dog recently who is shy and Top Tails has been so patient and allowing my dog to build up her trust on the walks. Highly recommend!

I was very nervous about leaving my cats alone for an upcoming trip and having Tanya gave me so much peace of mind while I was away. She always made sure they had everything they needed, that they played, and she sent me very thoughtful photos of them every day. I could not be happier!

Tanya has been a reliable friend to our cats when we're out of town. One of our cats bonded with her and obviously looked forward to her twice-daily visit. When we were back from vacation I noticed him watching the door at dinnertime and said "Ah, he's hoping Tanta shows up again!" He may have been disappointed in that instance, but that's the only downside for us with the Top Tails experience!

Tanya at Top Tails is terrific!
She's totally reliable and will go the extra mile to understand your pet's needs to keep him/her happy, which makes everyone happy.
I highly recommend her.
Tanya and Top Tails is fantastic and we rely on her for our ten year old pup Fiona.  She's always happy and safe on walks and visits.

Top tails has been amazing! Tanya is great with communication and always replies in a timely manner. Top tails accommodates us even when there are same day changes and are highly reliable. We appreciate the pictures and updates every visit. We know that Riley is in good hands with Top Tails!

Tanya is a fantastic cat sitter! From our initial meet and greet, we knew our Sylvia would be in great hands. She is extremely receptive and communicative. We love her daily check ins with pictures. I highly recommend her!!
